analysis.title: GS Digital Assets Need to Know
key_insights: Goldman's weekly crypto recap is titled 'No Panic'. The CMBI Total Market index is at 600.53, down 2% week over week, and the BGCI Index is at $2,137, down 2%.
CMBI Bitcoin is $81,341, down 1% on the week, with a 56.1% share of total crypto market cap. Reported spot volume over 24 hours was $8.9bn and active addresses were 634.6k.
CMBI Ethereum is $2,383, down 3% on the week, with a 10.0% market cap share. Reported spot volume over 24 hours was $3.6bn and active addresses were 753.4k.
Crypto exchanges are racing to offer prediction markets to US customers. Kalshi will allow futures bets using bitcoin-backed loans.
BlackRock filed for a bitcoin ETF that offers downside protection and upside exposure to IBIT.
Webull will begin a US rollout of perpetual futures in November.

Stablecoin infrastructure is expanding. Circle targets 40 new markets, Visa Direct moved USDC prefunding into commercial production with Inyo Global, and Coinbase will power stablecoin-backed cards for Marqeta customers. BIS economists say banks hold a lever over stablecoin adoption.
Bank involvement in crypto is growing. Deutsche Bank is preparing a crypto custody launch targeting Asia growth, and Standard Chartered signed definitive agreements to acquire Zodia Custody.
Solana's Alpenglow upgrade went live, described as the most ambitious upgrade since Ethereum's Merge.

Tokenization is advancing. SoFi is offering an interest-bearing tokenized deposit, Boerse Stuttgart's Seturion received a DLT trading and settlement license, Malaysia's central bank launched a depository for tokenized bonds and sukuk, and Ant International is using HSBC tokenized deposits to sweep idle cash into the tokenized BENJI money market fund.

On regulation, the OCC finalized a crypto rule, which the headline frames as a win for the digital asset industry. South Korea's crypto bill is nearing completion while the tax debate intensifies. The MAS-led BLOOM initiative expanded with Malaysia and Thailand central banks.
